_comment: A04 shared document-draft cases (plan section 6 T16, review S14). The demo engine (cl-ui company/demo/drafts.rs, WP-D) and the live engine (cl-api tests/contract_document_drafts.rs, WP-E; PENDING(U-95) until the pin bump) run the same cases and must give the same answers. WP-M froze the shape; later work packages only append cases to their own sections. Synthetic values only: no real names, files or amounts.

_schema.step: { "op": one of ops, "args": object, "as": optional label for later steps, "expect": { "status": HTTP status the engine answers, "code": engine error code or null, "draft_status": "new" | "ready" | "failed" | "converted" | "discarded" | null } }
_schema.refs: args may name an earlier step's result by its label: "$file1" (an attachment id), "$draft1.id", "$draft1.updatedAt", "$txn1.id". Amounts are decimal strings; dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
_schema.sections: claim (D1 claim answers), store (readings and stale tokens), discard, convert (D2 convert answers), attach (U-95 a, T9), guard (U-95 b, T7), amount_filter (U-95 c)
